facts.text: Evergreen students receive narrative evaluations instead of letter grades and design their own interdisciplinary paths.

sources.title: International Student Admissions | The Evergreen State College
sources.quote: You will design your own interdisciplinary path, receive narrative evaluations instead of grades, and learn through hands-on experiences rather than traditional lectures.

facts.text: Instead of declaring a major, students build their own area of emphasis from more than 40 fields of study.

sources.title: Our Learning Approach | The Evergreen State College
sources.quote: You can mix a variety of interests and, instead of declaring a major, develop your own area of emphasis in more than 40 Fields of Study based on your unique goals.
